verified_boundaries: Native taint, non-clean training access and FSM/legacy status conflicts cannot enter ranking, including warm-cache paths.

Unknown IDs cannot authorize themselves from completed files. Configured missing/incompatible/empty-declaration DB paths never fall back to offline artifact authority or create/migrate the database through update_report.
Changing clean-access policy or WATCH/FORBIDDEN/malformed access evidence invalidates qualification; backdated source changes are requalified.
Recomputing an unkeyed cache row checksum cannot invent scores or revive rejected evidence. Native cache schema 8 stores only a derived presentation snapshot.
Source mutation during the actual read rejects the unstable row while preserving the stable row. Successful native rows expose the same evidence_identity as the shared qualifier.
Native source/coverage follows full cfg.report, not metric_harvest/default display-column inference. Configured DB with no Lake object and empty inbox still supplies completed candidate IDs.
Legacy offline sort, zero/negative values, metadata fast path and unchanged-output mtimes are preserved; main/view JSON and Markdown mark lifecycle as unverified_local_artifact.
Native Lake pipeline FSM counts are intentionally distinct from evidence-qualified ranking counts. No-Lake pipeline coverage is explicitly labeled partial.
limits: See docs/report-authority.md. This item covers update_report and the orchestrator's ranking call, not all consumers or V1-01 as a whole.

CLI --report-only still opens an existing DB through the normal IdeaLake constructor, whose bootstrap/migration side effects remain open for the next reader slice. Direct update_report non-creation tests do not prove that CLI behavior.

With configured DB but no open Lake object, only supplied ideas and lifecycle-completed candidates contribute to the current pipeline view, not the complete catalog; pipeline_scope explicitly records that coverage.

Per-row stable contents are not a globally atomic filesystem/lifecycle snapshot or an immutable observation ledger. Duplicate delivery, historical result revisions and stale attempts remain subsequent work.
Native rows are requalified and content-hashed every report tick. This adds IO; no net research-efficiency benefit or GPU-hour saving is inferred.
Database-free offline cache compatibility is explicitly unverified. Old verifier/director and explicit convergence consumers must still be closed separately; adding labels does not fix them.
Admin queue, configured-DB read-only opening/catalog coverage, durable handoff/backpressure, stateful knowledge, independent attempts, CPU closure and holdout acceptance remain open.

No actual GPU, evaluator subprocess, paid provider, production license activation, package publication, deployment or live project mutation. Tests exercise real temporary SQLite/files/reports and explicit fault boundaries.
